_note: CNT_BYTE_ORDER CALIBRATION RESULT. This file is a PLACEHOLDER until step §20.7 has actually been run on a scrap tag. Do not guess the value: the Pi and the backend both refuse to start without it, because a wrong byte order makes every enrol_counter wrong and every velocity bound nonsense — silently.
procedure: Enable the counter and mirror on a scrap tag.
Read the NDEF and extract the 6 mirrored hex chars after the 'x'.
Whichever interpretation matches is the answer.
Record it in pi/.env AND backend/.env, and fill in this file.
